name: Kaitlyn in Chinaland: Chinese New Year
source:
When the self-consumed, all-American prom queen wannabe Kaitlyn gets sent to China as a punishment, she must navigate the waters of the language, the culture shocks... and the boys.

It's a West meets East romantic comedy about some of the pitfalls of living in China and struggling to belong.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151009040630/https://godline.itch.io/kaitlyn-in-chinaland-chinese-new-year]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当自我陶醉、想成为全美舞会女王的凯特琳被送到中国作为惩罚时，她必须在语言、文化冲击和男孩们的海洋中航行。

这是一部东西方相遇的浪漫喜剧，讲述了在中国生活和努力融入的一些陷阱。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151009040630/https://godline.itch.io/kaitlyn-in-chinaland-chinese-new-year]itch.io[/url]]
